# External Reference Documents — Project 001

Place external reference documents for the Inventory & Warehouse Management Uplift
project here (organisational charts, vendor proposals, discovery notes, governance
structures, existing stakeholder maps, etc.).

ArcKit can read PDFs, Word documents, and images directly. Documents placed here are
detected automatically and can be cited in generated artifacts.

> Note: Company-wide source material for Cycle Motion currently lives in
> `projects/000-global/external/` (`company-brief.md`, `stakeholders.md`) and is cited
> by this project's artifacts from that location.
</content>
